function: Excluded as above_phy: the learned agent selects the transmission mode, whether to use split inference (p. 1, 5-6); power is set by optimization (p. 7-8).
notes: Excluded as above_phy. The learned part (DDQN, tiny RL) only chooses between direct transmission and split inference: p. 1: "discrete transmission modes for sequential tasks"; p. 6: "outputs the decision of transmission mode at each time slot" (action space of size 2). This is an edge computing decision. Transmit power is not learned: p. 8: "Obtain the transmit power according to equation (28)", a closed-form KKT solution with SAA and ADMM (p. 6-7). The aerial-link exception of above_phy is not applied, since the learned output is the mode and not power. If the reviewer reads no_learning as also covering this case, the code would be no_learning. PDF is arXiv 2401.00445v1, same title.
